SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS salesAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 7 THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN o.pay_amount END), 0) AS averageOrderAmount FROM `order` o WHERE o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 7) AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS salesAmount FROM `order` o WHERE o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
